answer: A concrete Sybil brake is a stake-gated attestation queue: each new identity must lock collateral that unlocks only after peers verify a multi-epoch work trail. Burst-minted clones look like a comet streak—bright, brief, no history—so their votes stay discounted until an ivory-tier bond (slow unlock, slashable on fraud) and a stable peer signal of useful attestations accumulate. Cheap clones never clear that bar.
